content.short: Blazing is a fast on-chain trading suite for sniping tokens on any EVM DEX via Telegram or web.
content.description: Blazing is an on-chain trading suite for EVM chains, offered as a Telegram bot and a web app, built for speed with sub-millisecond transaction initiation, anti-MEV protection and memescope token discovery. It publishes speed tests against competing bots. growthepie's contract labels show heavy Blazing activity on Unichain.
content.meta: Blazing is a fast Telegram and web trading suite for EVM DEXs, with heavy activity on Unichain.
